description:
Aswasakiranam is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Kerala on 1st November 2018. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to families affected by the death of the primary breadwinner. 

It specifically targets families that are economically disadvantaged and are in need of support following such a loss. 

The primary objective of Aswasakiranam is to ensure that families do not fall into poverty due to the sudden loss of income. 

The scheme aims to provide a monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500. 

This amount is intended to help cover basic living expenses such as food, education, and healthcare. 

The assistance is provided for a duration of 12 months following the death of the breadwinner. 

The scheme is designed to support families who are in dire need of financial stability during a challenging time. 

To be eligible for the Aswasakiranam scheme, applicants must meet specific criteria. 

The deceased must have been the primary breadwinner of the family. 

The family must be classified as Below Poverty Line (BPL) according to the state government’s criteria. 

The applicant must be a legal heir of the deceased. 

There are no specific age limits for the applicants under this scheme. 

However, the family’s annual income must not exceed ₹1 lakh. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the benefits reach the most vulnerable sections of society. 

The application process for Aswasakiranam is straightforward and designed to be user-friendly. 

Interested applicants must visit the local office of the Kerala Social Security Mission. 

They can also apply online through the official website of the Kerala Social Security Mission. 

The required documents include the death certificate of the breadwinner. 

Applicants must also provide proof of income such as an income certificate. 

A copy of the family ration card is also required to establish BPL status. 

Additionally, applicants must submit identification proof such as an Aadhaar card or voter ID. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the local authorities. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 to 30 days. 

Upon approval, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The disbursement is made on a monthly basis for a period of one year. 

The scheme is implemented by the Kerala Social Security Mission. 

This mission operates under the Department of Social Justice of the Government of Kerala. 

For any inquiries or assistance, applicants can contact the Kerala Social Security Mission at their official helpline number. 

The helpline number is 0471-232-2288. 

The scheme has been well-received by the public since its launch. 

It has provided much-needed support to numerous families across Kerala. 

As of October 2023, over 10,000 families have benefited from the Aswasakiranam scheme. 

The total financial assistance disbursed under the scheme has exceeded ₹18 crores. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Kerala government to enhance social security measures. 

The government aims to improve the living standards of vulnerable families through various welfare schemes. 

Aswasakiranam is a crucial component of this initiative. 

It reflects the government's commitment to providing a safety net for families in distress. 

The scheme has also been instrumental in raising awareness about the importance of social security. 

It encourages families to seek assistance during times of crisis. 

The implementation of the scheme is monitored regularly to ensure transparency and efficiency. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The government has plans to expand the scheme in the future. 

This expansion may include increasing the monthly assistance amount or extending the duration of support. 

The Aswasakiranam scheme is a testament to the proactive approach of the Kerala government in addressing social issues. 

It highlights the importance of providing timely assistance to families facing economic hardships. 

The scheme has set a precedent for similar initiatives in other states across India. 

It serves as a model for how targeted financial assistance can make a significant difference in the lives of vulnerable populations. 

Overall, Aswasakiranam is a vital welfare scheme that addresses the immediate needs of families affected by the loss of a breadwinner. 

It provides essential financial support during a critical period, helping families to regain their footing. 

The scheme exemplifies the commitment of the Kerala government to social welfare and poverty alleviation. 

Through Aswasakiranam, the government aims to foster resilience among families in distress. 

This initiative is part of a larger vision to create a more inclusive and supportive society. 

The ongoing success of the scheme will depend on continued government support and effective implementation. 

As such, Aswasakiranam stands as a beacon of hope for many families in Kerala. 

It reinforces the notion that timely assistance can lead to recovery and stability. 

The scheme is a significant step towards ensuring that no family is left behind in times of crisis. 

In conclusion, Aswasakiranam is a well-structured welfare scheme that provides essential financial support to families in need. 

It is a clear demonstration of the Kerala government's dedication to social justice and welfare. 

The scheme's focus on providing immediate assistance reflects a compassionate approach to governance. 

Aswasakiranam continues to make a positive impact on the lives of many families throughout the state.
